findings.title: Several Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities Accidentally Posted To Public Kernel Mailing List
findings.summary_md: Phoronix reported that several unpatched Linux kernel vulnerability reports, including ZDI-CAN-33549 (CVSS 9.0 SMB Direct RCE via integer underflow) and ZDI-CAN-33774 (CVSS 9.0 KSMBD race condition RCE), were posted to the public Linux kernel mailing list rather than the private security list. The disclosure happened before fixes landed in mainline, with a patch for ZDI-CAN-33549 queued in a branch aimed at Linux 7.5.

findings.title: Two CVSS 9.0 Linux KSMBD RCE Flaws Disclosed on Public Mailing Lists Before Kernel Fixes
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported two CVSS 9.0 RCE flaws in Linux KSMBD disclosed on public mailing lists before mainline fixes. ZDI-CAN-33774 is a pre-authentication race condition; ZDI-CAN-33549 is an integer underflow in the SMB Direct path requiring RDMA-capable hardware. Neither had a named fix in mainline or linux-next as of publication.
